title: Kumar's 31 requirements + 5 sequence rules as machine-checkable rules
source: Kumar's numbered list (message of 04-11-2026). Text is verbatim-equivalent, grammar tidied, nothing added.
status: PROPOSED - a new build, needs Fable + external auditor + Kumar (see APPROVALS_LEDGER.json)
traceability_rule: every TASKS.jsonl task id touched at/after the cutoff must cite an R-id or S-id in title/why/note/src in at least one of its entries; otherwise ALERT 'unmapped work'
machine_checkable_note: Rules marked TRACE-only (R07,R10,R14,R17,R21,R22,R24,R25,R27,R28) cannot be proven by a mechanical check; the guard reports them AMBER (traceability only), never GREEN.

requirements.text: Where is my full database path on all boxes? Plan it so source databases can never corrupt - no UPS, power/network can fail any time, every file/DB move must be safe.
After the new retail pullers, how much will data size shrink? Two separate pullers - one non-recoverable, one recoverable on SSD - with proof of where the non-recoverable data is, per broker.
(After an incomplete answer) Wrong - real data was lost track of; there are bigger databases than reported.
Why second and third chances? Read the global instructions; how to change them; open CLAUDE.md for update (clickable link).
Build a puller exclusively for non-recoverable data on i5 and i7, same shared method, then stop the old pullers - with a clear three-source-proven non-recoverable list per broker.
Auditor file must name every live-only instrument per broker - full files, not summaries; public audit link; you do the work.
I do not want manual work.
Show who the three auditors are, what list was proposed, what they agreed/disagreed on, and both sides.

One table: every non-recoverable live-only instrument and which broker feeds it; another table for recoverable data on SSD. Full detail, must hold for years; sufficient for regime detection across timeframes, direction prediction and edge.
'Recording sessions' means pulling the data - full data. Finding the edge means not trading every day.

Overnight authority: agents in parallel, decide as admin. Objective only: retail-sufficient complete data for regime detection, ML, backtest, paper trading, live signals, intraday direction - all from my GUI. 4 premium brokers in parallel on both RAID-HDD machines protect live data; recoverable goes to SSD, pulled later to avoid load.

First tab of the new engine: every live-only non-recoverable data point, grouped, as live graphs - GIFT NIFTY, options, VIX, OI, futures, Bank Nifty, world markets, news/events, NIFTY50 volumes, BEES, FII/DII, each separately.
Use the public audit repo https://github.com/roopeshkumarb/onlyAuditFliles for audits, every time, for future use always.
Execute the gated CAVEMAN queue BLK-001..BLK-010: start with BLK-001, give proof, do not start BLK-002 until I verify.
Give a complete audit report with your own proof for an external auditor.
Do not be stuck on one access method: test direct SSH, DSM web port, i5-to-i7, Pi5-to-i7.
If a box is not responding assume a power issue - retry every 15 minutes, recheck now; do not wait on me.
Check all connectivity - a successful direct connection to every box.
Office laptop cannot install anything (GlobalProtect, Cortex XDR): give a safe script reaching all boxes and the local network.
The earlier .cmd/.bat worked, but Cortex XDR flags .bat files as dangerous and reports to IT - is there another way?
Travel phone: no camera, no GPS, Android, Google Play Store.
Continue - top-priority tasks now.

Add weekly-expiry recording and the missing live-only recorders without asking; it belongs in the data-needed list; check for similar gaps and audit with both reviewers; move SSD data on i5/i7 to HDD after market hours.
I'm sleeping - state the exact sequence until I'm back.
The three scheduled checks are existing-build maintenance, not future-build work.
Is 750 rows the data our engine needs? Does that satisfy the main goal? Why no visible progress toward it?
labels_1m does not exist - will it help the engine; is it pulled live or not?
State how each task connects to my main goal.

Is the audited, proven data-needed list ready? SSD/HDD load balancer? Live no-latency graphics engine? Only prebuilt proven tools? CPU/RAM/disk load balancers? List must specify live-only to HDD; recoverable to SSD temporarily on every device then moved to i5 and i7; Pi5 data also moves to i5.
Did you get my approval for the live-only to HDD setup? Is that list audited externally and by Fable? Is what is recorded enough to satisfy the main goal as a retailer?
Only prebuilt tools; anything built needs three approvals - Fable, an external auditor, and me. Running out of space on i7 and i5; finish what is needed to move to the new pullers - retailer_db_edge.

sequence.text: Before Friday: finalize the data-needed list, scoped to intraday regime detection across multiple timeframes, not the whole wish-list.
Then build retailer_db_edge by filling it from existing databases - not re-pulling from brokers; every row carries a stamp of which broker supplied it.
Once the base DB is ready and proven, switch new pulling to the new pullers built against the finalized list.
Only after the new pullers are running and proven, stop the old pullers completely - never before.
Friday 20:00 IST onward: every database on every machine moves off SSD entirely - only HDD and Google Drive.
